main_text.p: {CAP.} XIII. Transluncentes matutino probari censent: anc si necesse est, in quartam horam; postea vetant. Experimenta pluribus modis constant: primum pondere, si graviores sentiuntur: post haec corpore; factitiis pustulae in profundo apparent, scabritia in cute, in capillamento fulgoris inconstantia & priusquam ad oculos perveniat desinens nitor.
Ibidem. Tantaque differentia est, ut aliae ferro sculpi non possint, aliae non nisi retuso, verum omnes Adamante. Plurimum vero in his terebrarum proficit fervor.
main_text.head: ERRATA

page.notes: The opening word of the first paragraph is printed as "Cap.xiii." in small capitals with the heading mark; the word "Transluncentes" is as printed in the scan (likely "Translucentes"), and "anc" at line end is probably "tamen" or "ante" partly cut off, marked as read. Line ends in "anc" and "Transluncentes" are doubtful. The ERRATA heading is rendered as printed.
